purpose: Full-game diagnostic; observed NFL data and simulated league games are distinct cohorts, not a fitted or validated replica of the reference website.
limitations: Simulation uses one fixed 2026 Week5 league roster, ratings, depth charts, and injury state; each game starts fresh. This is not a simulation of actual 2025 NFL rosters or results.

The 64-game design covers two opponents per club. Bootstrap intervals resample these games conditional on these fixed rosters, matchups, policy, and engine settings; they do not represent uncertainty across roster releases, policies, or model parameters and do not establish general NFL calibration.
The 2023–2025 observed comparison overlaps the empirical reference's training period. It is descriptive benchmarking, not held-out validation.
Named offensive tactics, defensive choices, personnel, timing, and empirical sampling change together. These comparisons do not isolate the causal effect of any one component.
Call counts record submitted decisions, including calls replayed after pre-snap penalties. Game-stat denominators record credited plays only.
This harness reads and normalizes the native export and runs GameSim in memory. It does not test browser upload, full createStream migrations, or persistence.

The observed play-type filter excludes rare pass-attempt flags on no_play or special-teams rows, including two 2025 rows (intentional grounding and a blocked-field-goal recovery pass). Observed counts are not claimed to reproduce every official season total exactly.

The tactical callback calls native getPlayType(), which consumes native randomness. Its named play, formation, and clock branches also change subsequent random consumption. Shared seeds pair scenarios; only automatic versus undefined-decision interactive-auto is asserted draw-for-draw equal.

definitions.points: Final team points including all scoring types; both regulation and any overtime.
definitions.offensivePlays: Actual throws + sacks + rush attempts; includes spikes and kneels; excludes kicks, conversions, deleted/nullified plays. PBP uses run/pass/qb_kneel/qb_spike play types and statistical attempt flags. Penalties that leave credited statistics stand are included.
definitions.completion: Completed throws / actual throws; sacks excluded.
definitions.sack: Sacks / (actual throws + sacks); scrambles are rushes, so this is not sack/dropback rate.
definitions.rushYards: Native rusYds or PBP rushing_yards + lateral_rushing_yards, divided by rush attempts; includes kneels/scrambles.
definitions.passYards: Gross native pssYds or PBP credited passing_yards on completions, divided by actual throws; sack yards excluded.
definitions.uncertainty: 1000 percentile bootstrap resamples by whole game; deterministic seed872345; 2.5%/97.5% order statistics. Not significance thresholds or calibration acceptance bands.

policy.description: Native run/pass/special-play decisions; varied named concepts; pass-depth weighting from observed throw counts, with FTN screen/RPO/trick frequencies as declared sampling choices. This is a diagnostic policy, not inferred NFL coaching behavior. Core run concepts use explicit equal/repeated weights; short-yardage sneak chance25%; situational fronts with15% blitz. Only one club is controlled per game; opponent retains native offense. Normal huddle except final-two-minute urgency/protect-lead handling and late timeouts.
